title: About — Baruch
description: Learn about Baruch's story, mission and values. Responsible ecotourism and wellness.
heading: Who we are

sections.heading: Our story
sections.body: Baruch was born from a desire to share little-explored natural destinations with a human, sustainable approach. What started as weekend trips among friends is now a project dedicated to creating memorable experiences in harmony with the environment.

sections.heading: Mission
sections.body: Connect people with nature through responsible, safe and transformative experiences that foster physical, mental and emotional wellbeing.

sections.heading: Values
sections.body: Respect for the environment · Local community · Honesty · Safety · Holistic wellness. These principles guide every decision, from trail routes to the hospitality you receive.

sections.heading: Wellness focus
sections.body: We integrate mindfulness practices, conscious nutrition and moderate physical activity. It's not just about seeing landscapes: it's about being present and returning renewed.
